title: fix(gateway): keep Codex available after deferred agent startup
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Codex appearing as `unsupported-runtime` after an agent finishes deferred startup database preparation, even when its configured OpenAI route supports Codex. Follow-up to #165979.

## User Impact

Compatible Codex picker choices remain usable after background agent recovery. Existing model defaults, credentials, and explicit transport overrides retain their behavior. No configuration change, migration, or new option is required; updating picks up the corrected startup path.

## Why This Change Was Made

Startup retains the saved configuration separately from the defaulted input used to prepare secrets. Deferred agent recovery refreshed secrets from that defaulted input and published it as the saved source, so catalog compatibility defaults became apparent authored request overrides. Carry the existing authored source through the same refresh and guarded activation before model preparation.

Production delta: **+6 net lines** (8 added, 2 removed). The distinct saved-source and defaulted-preparation contracts require carrying one existing value across this boundary. There is no new cache, duplicate resolver, or compatibility path.

## Evidence

All heavy validation used **blacksmith-testbox**, lease **tbx_01m48a0njdhmsc9hbpqgh8zm71**, on base `a51a76bda63c`. The publication rebase onto `46ba1d11d1b1` preserved all four tested file blobs byte-for-byte; the lease was stopped before the head change.

- The final regression fails on the base because catalog defaults leak into the saved source (**36.07 s**, one expected failure), then passes both recovery cases with the fix (**51.38 s**). Different case counts; no speedup claimed. A separate route-level probe of the same production patch changes compatible runtimes from OpenClaw only to OpenClaw, Codex, and AgentsAPI.
- `pnpm test src/gateway/server-agent-database-startup.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: **13/13 passed, 97.87 s wall**. The existing file exercises real native database admission and Gateway lifecycle; the change adds assertions to existing cases and adds no Gateway/process boots.
- **27 related tests passed** across deferred-preparation sequencing, initial startup source preservation, secrets fast-path refresh, and request SecretRef refresh.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --staged`: core production types, all **27 core-test type graphs**, core/plugin graph boundaries, and preceding guards passed. The gate stopped at inherited unused exports: `OUTBOUND_GREETING_FALLBACK_MS` in voice-call and `modelCatalogRuntime.loadManifestModelCatalog`. Both reproduce on the untouched base. The voice-call export is already removed on current main; no unrelated fix is copied into this PR.
- All remaining selected lint and consistency checks passed (including scoped lint: **0 warnings, 0 errors**). No guard was disabled.
- Independent Codex review: **scoped-clean, P0–P2**. Exact-head [CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37451996483) passed on `a2920d026307` in **490 s (8m10s)**.

No production restart or config write was performed. Deployment verification, live native turns, and cloud/device placement remain outside this follow-up.
